notes: After a strong T1 (two Witch Hunt steals off Nyusha's mark), the Runner clicked for credits for all four clicks on T9-T13, going from 13 to 29 credits without running once, while the Corp advanced and scored Post-Truth Dividend and Tomorrow's Headline from Server 3 (card installed T12, scored T13) and then won with Flood the Market. Other mistakes: the Nyusha mark was named every turn but ignored after T1, a facecheck at HQ with 0 credits on T1, a Docklands Pass reinstall that was immediately trashed on T7, and Tremolo installed T8 but never used.

Rezzing Ivik for 7 on T4 and the Yagi-Uda score on T5 left the Corp at 0-3 credits for the rest of the game, so the R&D ice was never rezzed and the Runner ran R&D 13+ times (Sericulture and Fujii stolen). The AU Co. 'draw 2' was fired every turn into a full hand, forcing discards of 2-3 cards into an Archives that never got ice; Hybrid Release went to Archives on T11 and was stolen for the win. Hybrid Release was also installed T7 in Server 3 behind ice the Corp could not afford to rez, and was stolen.

The Runner stole three Server 4 agendas (T11-T13), but kept walking into F2P (twice on R&D on T6), which bounced Gauss each time and cost 2 credits per reinstall plus 2 per tag removal, so it sat at 0-2 credits from T13 to T16 (Artificial Cryptocrash took 7 more). At 6 points with 10-13 credits on T17-T18, and again on T21, it only clicked for credits instead of pressuring HQ/R&D, then lost to Next Big Thing on T22. It also ran into Klevetnik on T16 with 4 credits and no fracter.

Won 7-4 against a passive Runner with a clean scoring remote (Yagi-Uda T6, Hybrid Release T10, Yagi-Uda T11, Flower Sermon T14). The main errors: AU Co. overdraw forced discards on T11 and T13, both times sending Sericulture Expansion into an Archives with no ice, and both were stolen. T2-T4 were also slow: mostly clicking for credits at 8-13 credits with no remote set up.

Won by stealing five agendas, using Laser Pointer on Piranhas and Sang Kancil on N-Pot. But it repeatedly ran into rezzed ice it could not break: Jailbreak and Tread Lightly into Ping/N-Pot on T6-T7 before installing a breaker, Server 1 runs on T11-T13 with 2-3 credits against a 6-credit N-Pot break, and Ping on R&D on T10, T14 and T15. It also used Nyusha's mark click only twice, and stayed tagged while the Corp trashed Daily Casts.

Lost by decking on T23: the AU Co. ability (trash 1 from R&D, draw 2) was used every time it charged, even with R&D nearly empty and a full hand (discards on T12, T15, T21, T22). Rezzing Ivik for 7 on T3 left the Corp at 0-3 credits for 20 turns, and it still spent 2-credit clicks trashing Cookbook on T7, T18, T19 and T20. Hybrid Release went into a new Server 3 on T21 behind one Diviner and was stolen on T22.

A sensible Server 1 assault through Grubber (paying the subroutines) won 8 points. But from T8 to T13 the Corp sat at 0 credits and Paywall on R&D cost only the bad-publicity credit, yet the Runner made just one R&D run per turn and clicked for credits the rest of the time. Living Mural on HQ's Grubber (T11, 3 credits) was never used. It also let tags pile up for many turns, though the Corp could not punish them.

Took 4 points from R&D on T2, then from T3 to T15 mostly clicked for credits (up to 34) with a full grip, never installing a breaker or running R&D again. It ignored HQ while the Corp held 1 card (T10-T11). It let Kingmaking (T4), Artificial Cryptocrash (T13-T14) and Kingmaking (T15-T16) be advanced and scored in Server 2/4 without a single contest. Living Mural (T1) and the Funhouse tag removals cost money and achieved nothing.

On T3 the Runner stole Lotus Haze from HQ behind a single Hafrún and Hybrid Release from an Archives with no ice; another Hybrid Release left in HQ was stolen on T5. Rezzing Knowledge Seeker for 5 on T4 put the Corp at 0-4 credits for the rest of the game, so it could never play the Hedge Fund it held (seen T7) and left R&D's Anemone unrezzed while the Runner ran R&D freely T5-T14. It also spent 2 credits on T13 and T14 trashing Light the Fire! while broke.

Efficient remote scoring (Longevity Serum T2, Hybrid Release T6, Lotus Haze T10 and T13) against a passive Runner. Minor issues: R&D had no ice on T1-T2 and lost a Longevity Serum, and the T2 Longevity Serum trashed 3 of the 4 HQ cards for little gain. T7 was also three credit clicks at 7 credits when the Corp could have been developing.

Solid: Bladderwort for drip economy, Urtica as bait in Server 3, then repeated Server 4 scores behind Anemone (and later Saisentan), plus a never-advanced Hybrid Release in Server 5 on T12. Only quibbles: R&D ice never rezzed, which cost a Hybrid Release to Finality on T14, and Longevity Serum on T6 trashed 2 HQ cards needlessly.

From T6 to T20 the Corp did nothing but click for credits with a full 5-card HQ, discarding every turn, yet the Runner never ran HQ after T1 (until Beatriz on T20) despite having Gauss to break Capacitor. Instead it made one R&D run per turn through Paywall and clicked for credits, staying at 3-8 credits. On T8 and T11 it ran into Paywall and let the run end instead of paying 1. The T1 Into the Depths and R&D facechecks left it at 1 credit.

Rezzing Knowledge Seeker for 5 on T2 (on HQ) dropped the Corp to 0-5 credits for most of the game, so it never built a scoring remote, and Servers 1 and 3 held only Urtica traps. R&D was protected by one Anemone that the Runner went through every turn (Lotus Haze on T8 and T13, Hybrid Release and See How They Run on T15). Hybrid Release in Server 2 (T10) was stolen right away, and on T7, T9 and T13 the Corp clicked for credits instead of icing R&D.

Spent nearly every turn from T4 to T12 paying 2 credits a click to remove tags (from Behold!, Witch Hunt and Increased Drop Rates) and clicking for credits, so it never had money to run. Meanwhile the Corp advanced agendas over two turns in Server 3 behind unrezzed ice (T7-T8 Witch Hunt, T9-T10 Witch Hunt, T12-T13 Tomorrow's Headline) and the Runner never once ran Server 3. Carmen (T6, 5 credits) was never used, and the Nyusha mark was named but not run on after T1.

Won on T12 with good HQ pressure: Tread Lightly on T1, Maintenance Access with Nyusha's click on T7, and Tremolo plus Docklands Pass on T12. Mistakes: it reinstalled Daily Casts while tagged (T2, T4) only for the Corp to trash it, and Tread Lightly into a known Ping with no breaker on T9 was wasted. On T11 it ran Doomscroll while already tagged, which triggered the 2-tag damage and left it with an empty grip.

Lost on T8. Sericulture Expansion sat in HQ behind ice the Corp could not afford to rez and was stolen on T3. Project Yagi-Uda ended up in an Archives with no ice after the T5 Cultivate trash/discard and was stolen the same turn. On T4, T6 and T7 the Corp clicked for credits three times and discarded at end of turn instead of installing anything. Rezzing Ivik for 6 on T5 then left it broke.

Won with steady R&D runs through Paywall and a final run through the 4-ice Server 1 for Next Big Thing on T13. But on T11 it installed two Living Murals on the same Server 1 ice (6 credits, 2 clicks) and then ran R&D with 1 credit, which Paywall stopped. The T12 R&D run and the T3 run where it declined to pay Paywall were also wasted. With the Corp broke T6-T12, it should have run R&D more than once per turn.

Gave away the game through Archives, which never got ice: by T2 Flower Sermon and Sericulture Expansion had been put there (Cultivate trash/discards) and were stolen, and the T3 AU Co. mill sent another Sericulture there, stolen on T5. With 0-3 credits from T4, the R&D ice stayed unrezzed and the Runner won by running R&D on T7.

Fast remote scoring won it (Sericulture T2, Hybrid Release T3 and T6, Sericulture T10, Yagi-Uda T12). But R&D had no ice until T4 and HQ none until T6, and the Runner ran them 16 times on T1-T5. Getting no agendas from those runs was luck, not good play.

Reached 6 points by T8 (Remastered Edition and Oracle Thinktank from HQ/R&D/Server 2), then from T9 to T29 spent every click on credits (to 86) with a full grip and never ran. Meanwhile the Corp was also stalled and repeatedly discarded into Archives (T15, T24, T27, T29), and the winning Remastered Edition sat there until the Runner finally ran Archives on T30; the win was available for many turns.
